page: Microsoft Azure E4ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by a 3.7 GHz AMD EPYC 9V74 processor on the x86_64 architecture. Managed under Microsoft Hyper-V, the instance provisions 4 dedicated vCPUs distributed across 2 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The system includes 32.0 GB of memory, establishing an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio, alongside an integrated 236 GB NVMe SSD local drive and support for Premium Storage.

Benchmark results indicate strong single-core performance, highlighted by a stress-ng single-core score of 3080.18 and a Geekbench single-core score of 2103.0, both placing in the top 25 percent. Supported CPU capabilities include AVX-512 vector extensions as well as cryptographic flags like AES and SHA_NI. However, memory read bandwidth tests indicate lower relative throughput, and multi-threaded decompression results remain average.

By pairing a high ratio of memory per core with strong single-threaded clock performance and local NVMe storage, the E4ads_v6 offers efficient resource allocation for memory-bound tasks. Recommended workload fits include in-memory application caches, relational databases, static web serving, and general enterprise software servers where memory allocation and single-thread execution take priority over compute scaling.
